verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party bulk or batch operation for acting on many items at once. Write endpoints work one item at a time (mark a single action item complete, archive one, edit one note's agenda). List endpoints with pagination and the Super Admin workspace-wide export/delete are building blocks a developer could loop over, not a bulk-operation capability. The list-uploads endpoint only reports status for many uploads; it does not act on them.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
